CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

4. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

5. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

7. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   C. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.

8. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

11. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

12. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   D. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)

15. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)

----
